Looking for a stable full-time job where you can build a bright future? Join Vencomatic Group, a leading international family-owned company, and become part of our friendly and supportive warehouse team in Eersel. Whether you're an experienced warehouse professional or ready to take your very first step into logistics, we'll give you the opportunity to learn, grow, and develop new skills in a company that truly values its people. Ready for a fresh start or your next career move? We'd love to meet you! Wie zoeken we? What we're looking for: Availability to work in a two-shift schedule (day and evening shifts) A good command of the English language A proactive attitude with the ability to work independently Flexibility, reliability, and a hands-on approach A valid forklift certificate is an advantage, but not essential We're looking for someone who enjoys taking initiative, works well as part of a team, and is ready to contribute to a fast-paced warehouse environment. Wat bieden wij je? What you'll get in return: A competitive gross hourly salary of €15.20 Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per day Annual salary increases in line with the applicable Collective Labour Agreement (CLA) An attractive 30% shift allowance for hours worked after 18:00 Excellent opportunities for long-term growth and career development within a successful international organization In addition to great employment conditions, you'll join a stable family-owned company that values its people and supports their professional development every step of the way. Functieomschrijving As an Outbound Checker, you'll play a key role in ensuring our logistics operation runs smoothly and efficiently. Every day brings a variety of tasks, helping to keep products moving accurately and on time. Your responsibilities include: Scanning and processing outgoing goods Carrying out quality and quantity checks to ensure shipment accuracy Moving products within the warehouse and preparing them for transportation

Performing stock checks and inventory counts when needed Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organized working environment This is a hands-on role where attention to detail, teamwork, and a proactive attitude make all the difference
